paite: Ngai in, na kilawm hi, ka it; ngai in, na kilawm hi; na maituamna liah ah na mitte vahui bang ahi ua; na sam kelhon bang ahi, Gilead tang pang a kualte.
heading: Pasal

paite: Na hate mulmet thak belamnu hon bang ahi ua, sil khit phet a hong paitoute; huai ah amaute chiat in phik anei ua, alak ua kuamah aching a-om kei uh.
Na mukte khau san-au abang ua, na kam akilawm a; na mit laivomte theibuhfai them bang ahi, na maituamna liah ah.
Na ngawng David galvan koihna insang kilam bang ahi, lumbem neute sangkhat kikhaina mun, mihat lum in akivan uh.
Na nawite zuktal nou nih phikte abang ua, lili pak lak a tate.
Ni anem a limliap aman mateng murrah tang ah leh, begaw mual ah ka hoh ding.
Na kilawm hi, ka it; nang ah thilnin bangmah a-om kei hi.
Lebanon a kipan hon zui in, ka mou, Lebanon a pan kei toh, Amana vum a kipan dak in, Shenir leh Hermon vum a kipan, humpinelkaite kua a kipan, gialbemte mual a kipan.
Ka lungtang na tuahmangta, ka sanggamnu, ka mou; na mitte lak a khat in ka lungtang na tuahmangta hi, na ngawng a khainiang khat in.
Na itna kilawm na tel e, ka sanggamnu, ka mou! Na itna uain sang in nakpi in ahoihzaw! Na kinuh gim, gimlim chiteng sang in ahoihzaw.
Na mukte, Aw ka mou, khuaikhak bang in atakkhia a; na lei nuai ah khuaizu leh nawitui a-om; na puansilh gim Lebanon gim ahi.
Huan umsuak ka sanggamnu, ka mou; tui nak kihu, tui kivuh.
Na huansung theibuhfai, gah manphate toh ahi; spiknardi sing suan toh henna pak ahi.
Spiknardi leh pak gimlim, kepbuk leh singnamtui begaw sing tengteng; murrah leh aloe, gimlim pipen teng toh.
Huan atuikhuk na hi a, tuihing lui, Lebanon a kipan a lui luangte.
Khanglou in, Aw mallam huih; huan hong in, nang simlam; ka huan tung ah hong nung in, Na gimnamtuite aluankhiak theihna ding in. Ka ngaihnou ahuansung ah hong pai henla, atheigah manphate ne hen aw.
